activity.notes: Harsha (Harshavardhana) ruled from 606 to 647 and made Kannauj his imperial capital while extending Vardhana/Pushyabhuti power across much of northern India. The polity is registered as Vardhana Empire rather than conflating the ruler with later post-Harsha Kannauj regimes.

sources.citation_text: The reference identifies Harshavardhana as ruler of the Vardhana Empire from 606 to 647 and notes the empire's dissolution after his death.
